_about: Training overlap per model and fair-ground family, from each model's own published sources, read 2026-09-24. status: clean (source not in training), trained (source in training; our rows may or may not be the same split), sibling (a closely related source of the same task was trained on), unknown (training mix not published). Pretraining data of every base model (Qwen3.8, Qwen3.5, ModernBERT) is unpublished and is not assessed here; it applies to every row alike.
